structure: NJSLS-SS 2020 grade-band file for grades 9-12 (end of grade 12). Front matter (pp.1-12) identical to the other band files. Then 'By End of Grade 12 / Disciplinary Concepts' tables per strand: Disciplinary Concept | Description | Core Ideas. Then 'About the NJSLS-SS Eras' lists: 6.1 U.S. History Eras 1-16 (Colonization and Settlement 1585-1763 through Interconnected Global Society 1970-Today) and 6.2 World History/Global Studies Eras 1-6 (First Global Age through Contemporary Issues). Standards 6.1 and 6.2 are organized by era (era heading + short narrative paragraph + table Core Idea | Performance Expectations); Standard 6.3 Active Citizenship in the 21st Century by the End of Grade 12 is by strand/disciplinary concept. PE codes 6.1.12.<Strand><Concept>.<era>.<letter> (e.g. 6.1.12.CivicsPI.1.a), 6.2.12.<...>, 6.3.12.<Strand><Concept>.<n>. HS content is organized by era/topic, not by separate courses: course null, grades 9-12 throughout. Era narratives and Description-column cells labeled examples; concepts, core ideas, headings and PEs labeled standards.
